fields.description: The Slack alert to send when deals go quiet. Pick one and make sure it is turned on. Leave blank to switch these reminders off.
fields.label: Notification

fields.description: How many working days a deal can sit with no activity before we send a reminder. Holidays and weekends don't count.
fields.label: Inactivity Threshold (Working Days)

fields.description: Use each deal's Company holiday list. If a deal has none, we use the Holiday List below.
fields.label: Use each deal's Company holiday list

fields.description: The holidays to skip when counting working days. Leave blank to count every day (unless weekends are treated as holidays below).
fields.label: Holiday List

fields.description: Skip Saturdays and Sundays when counting working days, even if no Holiday List is set. Works together with any Holiday List above.
fields.label: Treat weekends (Sat & Sun) as holidays

fields.description: Also create a follow-up task on each reminded deal. The Slack alert still sends when this is off.
fields.label: Create a follow-up task on each flagged deal

fields.description: Title for the follow-up task. Insert deal details with placeholders, e.g. {{ doc.organization_name }}. The same title won't be created twice for a deal.
fields.label: Task Title

fields.description: Description for the follow-up task. Insert deal details with placeholders like {{ doc.organization_name }}.
fields.label: Task Body

fields.description: Alert the deal owner when a customer's email hasn't been answered in time. Uses the same holiday settings as above. (An admin sets up the actual Slack message — see the CRM XT README.)
fields.label: Incoming Email Alert

fields.description: Start tracking how long incoming customer emails go unanswered. Turn off to stop tracking. (Whether the alert actually sends is controlled by the Notification.)
fields.label: Track unanswered incoming email

fields.description: How long a customer email can go unanswered before we alert the owner. Choose the unit (working days or hours) below.
fields.label: Unanswered After

fields.description: Measure the time above in working days or in hours. Either way, alerts are never sent on a holiday or weekend.
fields.label: Unit
